changelog:
- Initial release of download-guard for Windows: protects disk space and download locations during typical install and download commands.
- Automatically monitors downloads, installs, and pulls (e.g., pip, conda, npm, git clone, docker, huggingface-cli, etc.) to prevent accidental C-drive fill-up.
- Checks and enforces download location, validates path and available disk space before starting, and blocks operations if paths are missing or unsafe (never silently falls back to C:).
- Keeps clear logs for every download and provides user-friendly status outputs and prompts on space or path problems.
- Disables itself for non-download operations, already-installed software management, and file writes below 1MB.
summary: AI Agent download guard (Windows only). Auto-activates on: download, install, git clone, pip install, npm install -g, pnpm add -g, bun install -g, conda inst...
